claims.text: Citing Rutskoi's assumption of office as Vice-President of the RSFSR under Article 121-7 of the RSFSR Constitution and Article 3 of the law on the assumption of office, the Congress releases Alexander Vladimirovich Rutskoi from the duties of member of the RSFSR Supreme Soviet and deems his powers as people's deputy for Kursk national-territorial district No. 52 terminated; signed R. I. Khasbulatov, Moscow, Kremlin, 10 July 1991, No. 1596-I.
claims.locator: Preamble, points 1-2; signature and date block
claims.uncertainty: A same-day act that gives no hour. A vice-presidential observation only; no term end.
